$comment: Every control (button or link a family can click) on a campus page, from a crawl of 44 live pages on 2026-09-16: where its destination comes from, who writes it, who owns it, and which check watches it. Human form: playbook/campus-page/controls.md. Element ownership for the same controls: spec/campus-page-field-map.json.

hero.stay-in-the-know.label: STAY IN-THE-KNOW
hero.stay-in-the-know.destination: # (opens the HubSpot popup form; no navigation)

hero.attend-info-session.label: Attend an Info Session
hero.attend-info-session.urlSource: fixed anchor; the strip itself is the events plugin

hero.book-a-call.label: Book a Call
hero.book-a-call.section: hero CTA row (and lower CTA rows)
hero.book-a-call.destination: https://go.alpha.school/<meetings path>[?uuid=<id>] (HubSpot meetings page for the campus); Dorado points at the events page instead
hero.book-a-call.urlSource: HubSpot Program call_scheduling_link, per Cristi 2026-03-11; UNVERIFIED: the 2026-09-16 export of the Update school pages workflow contains no book_a_call, meetings or call_scheduling reference (sync-mapping ticket filed 2026-09-17)
hero.book-a-call.writer: unverified (recorded as n8n-hubspot; not in the current workflow export)
hero.book-a-call.visibility: Elementor hide_desktop / hide_tablet / hide_mobile on widgets book_a_call_1 (hero) and book_a_call_2 (CTA row). Scan 2026-09-17 of 44 campus pages: 15 visible, 7 hidden with no link (correct), 3 hidden with a link (Oklahoma City, Tulsa, South Bay LA: defects), 19 older-template pages use unnamed widgets.

hero.apply-now.label: Apply now
hero.apply-now.destination: #resources (scrolls to the resources block where APPLY TODAY! lives); one page links the application directly

resources.apply-today.label: APPLY TODAY! (also Apply today, Apply for K-8, Apply for High School)
resources.apply-today.destination: https://alpha.school/application/?submission_campus=<slug> (32); https://alpha.school/application-fs/?submission_campus=<slug> for Finalsite-migrated campuses (3); https://apply.alpha.school/new-york (New York); /high-school-application/?submission_campus=<slug> for high school (5)
resources.apply-today.urlSource: HubSpot Program admission_link (n8n writes resource_4 link.url); the route behind it is legacy WordPress form, Finalsite redirect, or HubSpot redirect form (hubspot-program-admin)
resources.apply-today.notes: submission_campus must match the campus configured in the application form; a wrong slug diverts families to another campus

resources.info-packet.label: 2026/27 INFO PACKET, 2025/26 INFO PACKET, INFO PACKET, or the hidden placeholder INFO PACKET - update link
resources.info-packet.cssId: resource_1 (and a second slot on pages with two years)
resources.info-packet.destination: Flipsnack (www.flipsnack.com/BADA559BDC9/<packet>) on 56 buttons; alpha.school-hosted PDF on 5; Google Drive on 3
resources.info-packet.urlSource: packet-owner publishes the approved packet; APEX CampusPacketProfile holds pdfUrl and wordpressUrl for generated packets
rules: the placeholder button stays hidden until an approved packet exists
a 2026-27 button is visible only when that packet is approved (none approved as of 2026-09-16 per Matt Barge)
Google Drive links must be public; three return 401 today

resources.calendar.label: 2026/27 CALENDAR (variants 26/27 CALENDAR, 2026-2027 CALENDAR)
resources.calendar.urlSource: calendar A or B per campus (Admissions Hub calendar table; APEX INFO_PACKET_CALENDARS A = San Francisco PDF, B = Santa Barbara PDF); calendars role (Zara Raheem) publishes
rules: Announced campuses without a calendar hide the button (7 pages have none)
Google Drive calendars must be public; four return 401 today
